thought.text: Found it! Nginx is proxying ALL requests to Node backend instead of serving static client files. Fix nginx:

reasoning_content:
The issue is clear now - nginx is trying to proxy to port 3000, but looking at the nginx config, there's ALSO a static client in /opt/areloria/client/dist. The nginx config should serve static files, not proxy everything to the Node server!

Let me check the full nginx config for arelorian.de:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Get full nginx config
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cat /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/arelorian.de 2>&1")
print("Current config:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
